scope: Independent source and test review of current account-profile form lifecycle. No new browser execution or application edits in this review. Existing six actual-app cases are bounded evidence only.

findings.detail: The alive predicate checks aborted event-binding lifetime, captured operator object identity, connected form/dialog, current modal node identity and exact current form identity. After awaited updateCurrentUserProfile, it runs before currentUser assignment, modal close or success toast. Error handling similarly checks alive before message/button update.

WeakSet pendingProfileForms plus disabled-button and alive checks run before validation/request. Pending registration occurs synchronously before await. Finally deletes the exact form only. Failed active request restores its button and existing draft; no automatic mutation replay. Existing six cases cover one held synthetic duplicate and explicit manual retry.

Existing API PUT /auth/me contract preserved: trimmed display_name, trimmed nonempty email or null. Existing test checks nonempty email exact payload on refusal/retry; empty email?null and optional invalid email native validation are not independently asserted.

The test closes the old profile dialog before signing out, so form/dialog disconnected checks already reject the result. It confirms no sign-in replacement/success feedback, but does not isolate captured-operator or abort guard behavior. Do not claim isolated operator/abort proof from this case.

Closed/reopened and signout cases release a held route then wait250/200ms rather than explicitly observing the response consumed and any scheduled UI work settled. Existing guard is sound by source, but event-based settlement would make regression evidence less timing-sensitive.

recommended_bounded_followups.action: Add a late account-profile response after a replacement authenticated session, assert old response consumed, then reopen current profile and verify newer operator values/token/menu remain. Use existing mocked authentication paths; no real credentials or backend writes.
Replace fixed post-release waits with an explicit matched requestfinished/response-completion signal plus UI frame settlement, preserving deliberate focus assertions.
Add blank-email exact null payload and active-dialog failed response aria-busy removal checks, along with detached error response not adding private feedback.

limits: No independent actual browser rerun in this review; hashes bind inspected source/test/report.
Successful reopen uses returned response state, not backend fresh-GET persistence; existing report correctly states no persistence claim.
